governingRule: Do not lower the number of publishable events. Lower contaminated or premature drafts.

eventFirstClustering.rule: Sources merge only when actor, action, time window, and object or consequence substantially agree. Category and keyword overlap are supporting signals only.

mixedClusterSplitting.rule: Mixed clusters are split into separate canonical event dossiers instead of being rejected as a single poisoned draft.

canonicalFactLedger.writerRule: Writer uses only writingEligible fact IDs from the locked dossier.

integrityVsDepth.integrityRule: Integrity determines whether the story is safe to write.
integrityVsDepth.depthRule: Depth determines whether the output should be a developing brief, standard article, or deeper article.

dossierLocking.rule: Writer reasoning, body, headline, image, editor, and publisher reference the same locked dossier revision.

headlineFromLockedEvent.rule: Headline candidates begin with locked actor, action, and consequence fields and must agree with the dossier and lead.

semanticCategoryAfterDossier.rule: Collector and feed categories remain hints. Final semantic category comes from the completed canonical event dossier.

expectedOutcome: More coherent publishable dossiers, fewer contaminated drafts, fewer headline-source mismatches, fewer headline-lead mismatches, less topic drift, and lower repair-loop pressure without shrinking public output.
